channel.title: OmniSource Updates
channel.description: OmniSource is a curated, automatically maintained AltStore-compatible iOS app source. Every entry is resolved from the app's own official upstream project - GitHub Releases or the developer's official AltStore feed - and each download link is re-verified automatically.

item.title: Cercube for YouTube v6.1.3
item.description:
Cercube for YouTube 6.1.3 - the current official release (verified against apt.cercube.com on 2026-09-18).
This release improves caching, ad blocking, and compatibility with older iOS versions. - Added compatibility for iOS 15-16 - Minor bug fixes and improvements
Previously: 6.1.2 added dislike counts, sponsored segment skipping and 14 languages; 6.0.1 added compatibility for recent iOS versions.

item.title: Reynard v0.13.1
item.description:
Reynard 0.13.1 | Reynard
## Changes
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/minh-ton/reynard-browser/compare/0.13.0...0.13.1
This is a minor release that addresses issues found in 0.13.0. For the full changelog, see the [0.13.0 release notes](https://github.com/minh-ton/reynard-browser/releases/tag/0.13.0).
### Bug Fixes & Improvements - Improved the reliability of text input fields repositioning above the software keyboard when editing. - Fixed issues with the new toolbar minimizing behavior introduced in 0.13.0, including mistaken taps, misaligned page elements, and out-of-place sticky headers and menus, along with better behavior when resizing or zooming.
